decoded.meaning: A packed PATH body mixing NAME and PAIR elements (RFC-0029 4.1-4.2): NAME 'net', the PAIR (index=3, generation=1) spelled as the RFC-0018 escape record 00 16 08 <u32 LE index> <u32 LE generation> (11 bytes), then NAME 'temp'. Each element self-describes by its kind and declared length and is read by exactly one node.
decoded.note: Not a key: a chain is a frame path and never a canonical key (RFC-0029 5.1; v1.md 3.1), so path_lookup_key refuses these bytes while every codec carries them.
